description: IELTS Academic Writing: 60 minutes, Task 1 (at least 150 words, ~20 minutes, report on visual data — one third of the Writing score) and Task 2 (at least 250 words, ~40 minutes, essay — two thirds). Marked on Task Achievement, Coherence and Cohesion, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range and Accuracy. L1 Foundation covers Task 1 basics: the overview paragraph, trend language, and selecting key features for comparison. Task 2 essay skills arrive in L2-L4.
source: IELTS Academic Writing test format + Writing Task 1 public band descriptors — ielts.org / IDP IELTS (British Council / IDP / Cambridge English)
title: Writing
